item: The record of a collect run that raised says how far its pass got (sources chosen, sources processed, articles stored, and which of three bases those counts have)
summary: All 30 recent runs in each 2026-10-16 field bundle ended in a pool timeout and each carried only started/finished/error/hygiene, because the counts live in the return value a raising run never returns, so 'ingest starved' was visible only for the pass in flight. run_scrape_once now notes its counters as it ends and _do_run writes them into the errored record as pass_counts: sources_total, sources_processed, articles_stored and a basis word that is also the reason where they are null (pass_returned: the pass returned and its tail failed; pass_raised: the pass raised, counts are every source whose worker returned a result by the time it ended, including the sources a pool finished after the failure surfaced; not_reported: the failure came before the pass counted, all three null, never 0). Reset before every run, the class of the failure only, a run that returned does not repeat the counts. Adds 117-136 bytes of JSON to an errored row (measured on the real record in a test), at most 4.1 KB for the 30 rows of scheduler.recent_runs (field rows: 430-963 bytes, 25.5 KB). The History tab still shows the error class only.
